scope: Four actual floor apertures with closed slab edges. Units below are final world metres unless labelled model.
minimumPassageReason: The current player capsule has diameter 0.70 m; clearance on either side of a central 0.07 m pole requires a floor aperture wider than 1.47 m. The selected 1.60 m includes a small movement margin.
lowestFloors: Solid and retained as the landing and pole support.
interaction: Existing gravity and collision apply. Dedicated pole ascent/descent remains intentionally unimplemented.
